topLevel.why: Y folds the content-free 'Appendix' heading into the 'It From Byte' material it introduces, and groups the three trivial footer lists into one part. X gives a whole top-level part to an empty 'Appendix' heading and splits the boilerplate footer three ways. Otherwise the two trees divide the document identically.

gists.why: Y's subsection gists for the Blessings and Prospects passages state what those stretches actually argue, where X reuses broad part-level gists. X wins clearly on passage 8, where its TM Meta-Learning gist matches the text and Y's is generic and about a neighbouring question.

weldedParts.why: Merges the document's separate Backlinks, Similar Links and Bibliography headings. This is minor, since all three are boilerplate lists.

inventedClaims.what: Says each GPT generation 'looked unimpressive on paper', but the section calls GPT-1 interestingly useful and GPT-2 impressive.

overall.why: Y has a cleaner top level with no empty Appendix part, and its gists are more specific on most sampled passages. X's better TM Meta-Learning and pretraining gists do not outweigh this.
